//: ΕΛΠΙΣ DNS network map. js/app-map.js draws every entry in "networks" as a node on the map and a card under it, and every entry in "cities" as a place the nearest node reaches. Coordinates are decimal degrees; "place" is free text, so a network whose town is not public can just say its country. A city with "side": "left" has its name drawn left of the dot.

view.//: What the map shows first, and what the reset button goes back to: west, south, east, north.

networks.name: Perfect Network
networks.notes: EDNS Client Subnet is switched on here, so YouTube and every other CDN hands back a cache near you rather than near us. The DNS64 endpoint lives here as well.

networks.name: Origin TechLab
networks.notes: The busiest endpoint in the project, and a second opinion inside Malaysia when one upstream is having a bad day.

networks.name: Shana Network
networks.notes: Answers from Singapore. The way out when a local resolver develops opinions.

networks.name: kevin.moe
networks.notes: A community network, and one of the four autonomous systems the project stands on. Four operators means no single one of them can switch ΕΛΠΙΣ off.
